subtitle: 귀환석 한 마디가 부른 텔드랏실 왕복 참사

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
저기 고수님, 서부 몰락지대에서
이 침낭 뭐예요?
15렙도 누울 수 있어요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly high-angle three-quarter shot in sleek 3.5-head Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, Dwarf Hunter lounges cozily inside a warm beige-brown medieval quilted wool sleeping bag with leather straps on a minimal patch of dry grass, her blunderbuss gun slung on her back and her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief curled beside her. On the right, Night Elf Priest leans forward eagerly with sparkling wide eyes and her cleric staff stowed on her back, gesturing curiously at the sleeping bag.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
경험치 버프 주는 침낭퀘인데
1시간 반 걸려요. 가시덤불이랑
불모의 땅 거쳐서 같이 갈래요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic side-angle wide shot on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, Dwarf Hunter stands confidently with her gun slung on her back, holding out an unrolled parchment map with a proud grin while her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief sits at her boots. On the right, Night Elf Priest clasps her hands excitedly in anticipation, with a small hooded background Night Elf companion standing eagerly behind her.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
고수님이 돌발톱 산맥에서
귀환석 타라셔서 바로 썼어요!
저희 둘 다 돌라나르 도착!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium close-up shot centered on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Night Elf Priest stands in the center with her cleric staff stowed cleanly on her back, cheerfully holding up a smooth oval blue-swirl glowing Hearthstone in both hands. Bright cyan teleportation light ribbons swirl gently around her and a small blurred newbie silhouette beside her as she waves happily.

Dramatic deadpan freeze-frame close-up on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dwarf Hunter stands frozen like stone in the center with blank white shock eyes, mouth slightly open, and a comical pale ghost-like soul drifting out of her head as she slowly realizes the mistake. Beside her boots, her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief tilts its head in awkward silence.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
결국 돌라나르까지 데리러 가서
소라딘의 성벽까지 찍었네...
원래 이런 짓 안 하는데 뭐에 취했나.
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle tracking shot on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, an utterly exhausted Dwarf Hunter trudges forward with hunched shoulders, heavy dark circles under her eyes, and her blunderbuss slung on her back, gesturing weakly toward a tiny stone wall ruin marker in the minimal foreground. On the right, Night Elf Priest trots cheerfully behind her with a carefree bounce. Behind her, her equally exhausted ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief waddles along panting with tiny sweat drops.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
고수님 덕분에 침낭 얻었어요!
앞으로 침낭 깔 때마다
고수님 평생 기억할게요!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder comic finale shot on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the right, Night Elf Priest is tucked blissfully inside a brand-new warm beige-brown medieval quilted wool sleeping bag with leather straps, her staff resting neatly beside her as she beams brightly with a happy wave. On the left, Dwarf Hunter sits slumped face-down against a small wooden crate in complete physical and mental exhaustion while her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief pats her shoulder.
